cubicasa-fusion.joblib.what: per-template counting models, fit on train+val with det_* features of symbol-det.pt (preset B); test 81.8% exact

wallseg.pt.what: U-Net ResNet-34 wall segmenter, fp16 weights; 60 test plans wall F1 0.925
